definition: A false friend. English black tea is Chinese 红茶 hóngchá, “red tea”, named for the liquor. Chinese 黑茶 hēichá, “black tea”, is the post-fermented class this atlas files as dark. Two languages, two teas. Puer’s relationship to 黑茶 is contested; the atlas files it with the dark teas by process, not as a settled legal subset.
